messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed a customer got charged twice when a streaming request hit a fallback region and a tool_call retried after truncation. Minimal repro below. Anyone own routing/ledger side?
kevin: Yikes. Got logs? Which model/region? Could be idempotency key missing on toolcall replay.
ash: Quick note: router debug flags show a route-handoff at 12:03:17 where session_id changed. That seems suspicious.
maria: Paste of the most relevant log lines:```
2024-09-11T12:03:16Z INFO router route=us-west-2 -> us-east-1 session=abcd-1234 toolcall=tc-9876 prefix_tokens=42
2024-09-11T12:03:17Z WARN runtime truncate-triggered session=abcd-1234 -> new_session=efgh-5678 truncated=true
2024-09-11T12:03:17Z INFO router replay-toolcall toolcall=tc-9876 session=efgh-5678 charging=provisional
2024-09-11T12:03:18Z INFO billing confirm-charge toolcall=tc-9876 session=efgh-5678 charged_tokens=42
2024-09-11T12:03:18Z INFO billing confirm-charge toolcall=tc-9876 session=abcd-1234 charged_tokens=42
```
ash: That two-line confirm looks like double confirm for same toolcall id but different sessions.
ash: If the router hands off and the runtime issues a replay under a new session, we lose idempotency unless toolcall id stays canonical.
samir: Also watch the TTL/ack semantics: streaming prefix tokens were provisionally attributed to route A but confirmed after route B replayed. Our ledger currently treats provisional credits + confirmed credits separately, leading to double billing in edge cases.
kevin: We should instrument a combined trace that surfaces: session_id, original_session_id, toolcall_id, route_id, provisional_id, and final_charge_id. Console waterfall should show mapping. Right now it's too opaque.
maria: Agreed. Short term: can we make billing prefer confirmed charge with matching toolcall_id and dedupe provisional? That would be safer for customers.
samir: Dedupe will require canonicalization rules. If a toolcall_id is present, prefer the first confirmed charge and refund duplicates. We need policy approval for auto-refunds.
kevin: For engineering: two parallel actions — 1) router/runtime: propagate original_toolcall_id and avoid regenerating session ids mid-stream where possible. 2) billing: add a dedupe pass for confirmed charges keyed by toolcall_id + model + customer.
maria: I'll put together a tiny repro script (curl + streaming) and drop sample ids here. Can someone from routing take a look at the handoff code?
kevin: I'll take router change. I'll open a PR to carry X-Original-Toolcall-ID on fallback and a quick unit test.
ash: For visibility, console team — can we add a temporary column in the provisional charge table: "route_hops" and "toolcall_id"? Even a toggle would help investigations.
samir: Also propose a telemetry flag: emit billing.trace_id that ties provisional->confirmed transitions. That will let ops reconcile without digging logs.
maria: Ops-bot, please file a short incident so support can notify the customer and we can track refunds if necessary.
ops-bot: Incident created — INC-2024-1123: streaming fallback double-charge. Assigned to eng-platform oncall. Link: https://redwood.internal/inc/INC-2024-1123 :white_check_mark:
kevin: Cool. I'll aim to have the router PR by EOD and a console mock for the column tomorrow. If we need a hotfix for billing dedupe, we should schedule it next sprint.
maria: Thanks team. I'll add repro ids in DM and ping legal/product about the refund policy. :thumbsup:
